summary: Iteration 22 tested Obserra iter22 features: (1) card view filters on /app/team, /app/vendors, /app/agents; (2) weekly-guide-refresh cron secret gate; (3) two-pane on /app/vendors and /app/controls; (4) Settings recipients book chips. Backend: 6 passed + 1 skipped (all 3 recipients-book tests + 2 cron 401 tests + previously validated 200 for weekly-guide-refresh; the valid-secret call was skipped on retest to avoid hammering the heavy background Playwright capture as advised). Recipients PUT correctly drops invalid emails ('not-an-email', ''), dedupes 'it-lead@obserra.demo' and trims '  spaced@obs.demo  '; GET returns the persisted list; ops user gets 403 on both GET and PUT. Weekly-guide-refresh returns 401 without/with wrong Bearer and 200 {status:'accepted'} with the unquoted 64-char WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET. Frontend on 1920x1080: /app/team search 'zzznope' filters table 2→0, role=executive filters correctly; /app/vendors search 4→0, tier=Critical shows 2, clicking left of first vendor row opens vendor-detail-pane containing vendor-detail-assess, close hides it, table still visible; /app/agents (broken before fix) now loads 3 rows, search filters to 0, status=sanctioned shows 2; /app/controls clicking left of first control row opens control-detail-pane with control-detail-pack, close hides pane, table still visible; /app/settings save chip persists to backend (round-trip PUT/GET), chip click fills email-docs-input, book-remove-* deletes chip (4→3), persisted across reload; mobile 390px cards render for team/vendors/agents with filter bars and no horizontal overflow. Two critical crashers were found & fixed during testing (see updated_files).
action_items: Review the two runtime-error fixes applied by the tester: AIAgents.jsx (added missing q/statusF useState) and Settings.jsx (added missing Bookmark & X imports from lucide-react). Both pages threw ReferenceError and were completely non-functional before the fix — please double-check the intended state defaults ('' / 'all').

Team.jsx desktop table AND mobile cards were iterating raw members instead of shownMembers so member-search and member-filter had no visible effect (mobile also unfiltered). Tester changed both maps to shownMembers.map — please review.
critical_code_review_comments: AIAgents.jsx line 24 referenced statusF and q which were never declared with useState — page crashed on mount with 'statusF is not defined'. Missed in code review.
Settings.jsx JSX used <Bookmark/> (line 323) and <X/> (line 331) icons but neither was imported from lucide-react — Settings page crashed on mount with 'Bookmark is not defined'.

Team.jsx computed shownMembers but rendered members.map in both the mobile card list (line 102) and the desktop table (line 120). The filter UI (member-filters) was cosmetic — no rows were ever filtered. Fixed to shownMembers.map in both places.

cron/weekly-guide-refresh triggers a heavy background Playwright browser capture inside the FastAPI worker. During iter22 backend the public gateway became unresponsive for ~5 minutes after one authorized call — while multiple 'monthly board report' cron tasks were also running and hitting 429 on the email integration. Consider throttling or offloading to a proper worker queue; the current pattern can starve the API loop.
Login flow duplicate onboarding overlays (executive tour + advisor auto-open) still create a UX papercut for admins and cause repeated dismiss steps in every automated test.

AGT-* agents list, TEAM members list, VENDOR list — none uses server-side filtering. Fine at current scale but the filter chips (role/tier/status) should probably be reflected in the URL for shareable views.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Team desktop row testid is member-{id} (NOT member-row-*). Vendor rows use vendor-row-{ref}, Agent rows use agent-row-{ref}, Control rows use control-{control_id}. To open a two-pane row without triggering an inner action button, click ~30px from the row's LEFT edge via page.mouse.click(box.x+30, ...). Login via Enter key (auth-submit click still flaky). Onboarding + advisor auto-open every session — dismiss both. Do NOT re-call POST /api/cron/weekly-guide-refresh with the valid secret repeatedly; it launches a heavy background Playwright capture and can starve the backend event loop for minutes. Recipients GET/PUT endpoints strip quotes/trim/lowercase-agnostic dedupe; regex is r'^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$'.
rca of the issue: AIAgents crash: useState hooks for q and statusF were omitted while wiring the filter bar. Settings crash: lucide-react named imports Bookmark and X were not added when the recipients-book UI was introduced. Team filter no-op: filter state and shownMembers derivation were added, but the JSX kept iterating the original members array in both breakpoints. All three are typical incomplete-refactor slips introduced when adding the same filter bar pattern across four pages — Vendors and Controls were correctly updated to iterate their shown* arrays; Team was missed. Mitigation applied by tester: add missing state, add missing imports, swap members.map→shownMembers.map (both mobile card map and desktop tbody map).
